allow_large: The owner chose on 2026-09-30 to move workers, fixes, design and the cold reader to GPT-6.1 Sol while reviews stay on GPT-6 Sol; model names and the SDK pin appear in several source files and the tests that pin them
done_when: Workers, fixes, design and the cold reader default to gpt-6.1-sol at their current efforts (this repo's forge.toml and forge init's defaults), while reviews, the light prototype review and the sign-off review stay on gpt-6-sol; Luna stays gpt-6-luna; the Codex SDK pin is 0.159.2, matching the Codex CLI; forge doctor passes and tests check the defaults, the review pins and the SDK pin

findings.body: This test checks the TOML written by `forge init`, but never runs `forge work` with that configuration. The command-level worker tests use a separate GPT-6 Sol fixture (`tests/test_codex_worker.py:30-34`), so they would still pass if Forge selected the old model for an initialized repo's build or fix round. Add a command-level test that checks the model and effort sent to the Codex app-server for these rounds.
findings.title: Not done: an initialized repo's forge work sends GPT-6.1 Sol for build, fix and lite rounds

findings.body: The new test checks the generated grill entry, but does not run `forge read` with it. The command-level reader test supplies its own GPT-6 Sol configuration and asserts that old model (`tests/test_codex_reader.py:24,109`). A regression in the default cold-reader route would therefore pass the suite. Exercise `forge read` using an initialized repo and assert the app-server receives GPT-6.1 Sol at high effort.
findings.title: Not done: an initialized repo's forge read sends GPT-6.1 Sol for the Codex cold reader

findings.body: The fallback default is now GPT-6.1 Sol, but the user guide still says `gpt-6-sol` at high effort (`docs/guide.md:107-110`). A user following the guide will expect a different model from the one Forge selects when Claude is unavailable. Update that statement to match the changed default.
findings.title: Update the guide's Codex design fallback default

why: GPT-6.1 Sol is out and about 40% cheaper at the same speed, but in side-by-side reviews it missed or under-rated known blocking problems that GPT-6 Sol caught
